summary: WWPG lets stationary CEE and Power Grid machines share power through either mod's wires.
changes: Adds tested support for NeoForge 21.1.248 alongside 21.1.231.
Allows newer NeoForge, Create, CEE and Power Grid versions for player testing; only the listed combinations are verified.
Keeps extension API 1.0.0 and existing worlds compatible.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.231 or 21.1.248, Java 21, Create 6.0.10-280, CEE 1.1.3, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.8. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Pinout editions also require CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1.
